Confidence.description:
How much to trust the state beside it.

Never presented without the claim it qualifies. With thirty nodes reporting, the system says so; it does not quietly present the same number it would give for four hundred.

reportable.description: The contract's served judgement; clients never restate its thresholds.

stability.description: agreement with recent estimates for this zone

LOSBand.description: Operational density band. Always rendered with its word and its number.

band.description:
Operational band, classified on density (see standards.band_for_density).

CRITICAL means at or beyond capacity density — the point where flow stops improving and starts to collapse — not a high flow number.

density_persons_m2.description: persons per square metre — the AUTHORITATIVE measure. Flow is not monotonic in density (it peaks then collapses), so a band cannot be read off flow alone: a jammed corridor and an empty one look alike.

estimated_population.description:
Observed devices scaled by measured participation.

The single most load-bearing number in the system, which is why participation_rate is measured rather than configured.

flow_ped_m_min.description: pedestrians per metre width per minute — reported, not classified on

los_grade.description: Full Fruin grade A-F. Console only; the app never shows this.

net_flow_per_min.description: Positive means filling. Sustained positive net flow is the early warning.

over_capacity.description: Past the peak of the fundamental diagram: more arrivals now reduce throughput. The single most important operator signal.

queue_excess.description: people who do not fit at jam density, i.e. backed up behind
